On 1 September 2026, does Article 50(1) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (rules on penalties) already apply?

response.text: Is Article 50(1) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, which sets out the rules on penalties, already applicable as of 1 September 2026?
